create_action_scale_wrapper: create a Wrapper instance that rescales environment actions to a custom minimum and maximum range
wrap_env_with_new_bounds: wrap a dm_env Environment with new action bounds using the Wrapper constructor
step_with_scaled_action: call step on the Wrapper to automatically transform and scale actions before forwarding to the environment
inspect_wrapped_action_spec: call action_spec on the Wrapper to retrieve the rescaled BoundedArray with new minimum and maximum bounds
reset_wrapped_environment: call reset on the Wrapper to delegate environment reset through to the underlying dm_env Environment
